card.text: Explore Larissa with Voyager 2 imagery and its source-backed irregular shape.

introduction.text: Larissa is a small, irregular moon orbiting close to Neptune. Voyager 2 resolved a dark, cratered surface, but only a limited part of this distant world has been seen.

normal.title: Clear-filter mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness is corrected for illumination. The gray grid marks the unseen side, withheld shadows and unreliable samples.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 96 km sphere, from a Voyager shape model. Unseen terrain is modeled; small features are uncertain.
